Hymn 147: Sweet Is the Work
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: John J. McClellan
Lyricist/Text Author: Isaac Watts
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 147 titled "Sweet Is the Work" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by John J. McClellan and the lyrics were written by Isaac Watts.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
